entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: EMM message sent by the UE to reject a modification of an EPS bearer context requested by the network.

entities.name: Modify EPS bearer context procedure
entities.description: Procedure for modifying an existing EPS bearer context, which may be rejected by the UE using the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element included in the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message indicating the reason for rejection.

relations.description: The MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message is a possible step in the modify EPS bearer context procedure when the UE rejects the modification.
The MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message contains the EMM cause information element to indicate the rejection reason.
